title: Turn a possible calling into a small commitment

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: A calling hypothesis connects an offered ability to a need someone actually recognizes. Meaning for the contributor and usefulness for the recipient are separate; disappointment can prompt a change without deciding an entire vocation.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Fictional room coordinator Jo requests a private 20-minute transcription of three notice facts: book swap, June 12 at 14:00, Room B. Jo wants plain text, no graphic design or participant names, delivered by Friday 16:00. Ari has 25 free minutes and suitable typing access. Jo agrees to inspect one draft but promises no continuing role.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Write the contribution hypothesis, produce the three-fact text and account for time, permission and the recipient’s requested format. Save the draft before the response in the check.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A helper offers publicity; the recipient requests quiet filing and declines a public post. Which purpose should govern the proposed contribution?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: A fitting artifact preserves event/date/time/place with no invented details. Later fiction: Jo receives it Friday 15:30, confirms all facts and asks for no further work. That supports one useful supplied contribution, not sustained calling or actual service by the reader. Partial: facts right but unwanted design added. Incorrect: invent a recurring role or gratitude. Next choose another bounded offer only if both need and capacity remain.
criteria: One outcome is not inflated into a vocation

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: The requested useful work and actual permission govern. Offer filing if competent and willing, change the offer, or stop. Public visibility cannot be imposed to make the helper feel purposeful.
criteria: One outcome is not inflated into a vocation
